rule: A query must be phrased the way somebody would actually ask, NOT in the entry's own vocabulary. Queries lifted from an entry's name or description score 1.000 against every ranker ever measured here, including one that ignores the body entirely — they test nothing. If you add a query, write the question first and only then check which entry should answer it. See ROADMAP Phase 7.
